meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 Resend 邮件适配器复制进 src/channels、注册并安装对应依赖,再构建并跑注册测试。随后引导你完成 Resend 账号、域名、API key 和 webhook 配置,把你自己的邮箱设为 owner,并发一封问候邮件。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮件渠道时触发,例如正在走 /setup 流程。Resend 账号注册与域名验证需要你本人在后台手动完成。

say.text: 帮我接入 Resend 邮件渠道
say.note: 它会复制适配器、装依赖并跑测试

say.text: 把我的邮箱设为 owner,让 agent 回我的邮件
say.note: 会注册你为 owner 并发出问候邮件

say.text: 发信报 401,检查一下 API key

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude copies the Resend email adapter into src/channels, registers and installs it, builds and runs its registration test, then walks you through Resend account, domain, key and webhook setup and emails you a hello.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw, such as during /setup. Resend account and domain verification are done by hand in the dashboard.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs tests

say_en.text: Set my address as owner and have the agent reply to my email
say_en.note: Wires you as owner and sends a hello

say_en.text: Sends fail with 401 — check the Resend API key
say_en.note: Points to the API Keys page in Resend
